# Readyio

> AI Website Design Company & Smart CRM Automation

Readyio designs and builds high-converting custom websites, tailored CRM systems, and practical AI workflow automations through one accountable technology team.

## Core Capabilities

- **Custom Website Design & Web Applications**: Modern, responsive, high-performance web applications, customer portals, and landing pages designed for conversion and speed.
- **CRM & Business Systems**: Custom internal platforms, sales pipelines, lead routing, customer databases, and integrations built around how teams actually operate.
- **AI & Workflow Automation**: Production-grade AI chat and voice agents, automated lead follow-ups, document processing, and multi-tool workflow automations (n8n, Zapier, custom APIs).
- **Tech Partner For Founders**: Turn ideas into working first-version products (MVPs), milestone-based development, and launch support.
